channel.title: Path of the Dragon – Book Updates
channel.description: Latest chapters and appendices from Path of the Dragon.

item.title: From My Heart
item.description: A personal invitation to explore wholeness, myth, and the nature of reality, grounded in lived experience, curiosity, and ethical responsibility.

item.title: Your Path, Your Pace
item.description: A personal invitation to explore wholeness, myth, and the nature of reality, grounded in lived experience, curiosity, and ethical responsibility.

item.title: Foundations ofthe Dragon’s Path
item.description: Enter the Dragon’s Path through embodied integration: raw Serpent fire taking ethical form, with room for longing, numbness, and a beginning at your own pace.

item.title: Chapter 1: Awakeningthe Dragon
item.description: Distinguishes raw Serpent force from the integrated Dragon, tracing surge, numbness, somatic regulation, and embodied becoming.

item.title: Chapter 2: Core Principles
item.description: Five foundations for the Dragon’s Path: Interconnectedness, Paradox, Conscious Power, Integration, and Accountability.

item.title: Chapter 3: Primal & Transcendent
item.description: Maps the Five Energetic Bodies, witnessing attention, and the Axis of Being where vertical depth meets lived relationship.

item.title: Chapter 4: The Inherent Rhythm
item.description: Explores the Creator–Destroyer rhythm: contraction, fallow, endings, and renewal as phases of transformation that require timing and practice.

item.title: TheEntangled Firmament
item.description: Science, myth, philosophy, and contemplation meet beneath one sky. Explore recurring relations while keeping evidence, wonder, and metaphysical wagers distinct.

item.title: Chapter 5: Bridging Worlds
item.description: Approaches the Entangled Firmament through science, myth, spirituality, and philosophy, preserving the distinct claims each can make.

item.title: Chapter 6:Interconnectedness
item.description: Makes interconnectedness visceral rather than abstract, using web, mycelium, and breath to show how action ripples through shared reality.

item.title: Chapter 7:Dynamic Emergence
item.description: Explores novelty and heredity through interaction, complementary templating, variation, and thresholds, without placing purpose in the genes.

item.title: Chapter 8:Participatory Reality
item.description: Shows that perception is interface, not mirror: awareness, expectation, bias, and embodied state shape the lived reality you actually inhabit and act from.

item.title: Chapter 9:Bounded Infinity
item.description: Explores infinity through finite form: multiverse models, fractals, creative constraint, living boundaries, and the limits of human repair.

item.title: Chapter 10: Graphs of Reality
item.description: Uses graph and computational metaphors to make relation, feedback, recursion, and transformation structurally legible beyond linear self-help thinking.

item.title: Chapter 11: TheLimits of Logic
item.description: Approaches the limits of logic through Russell, Gödel, prediction, and apophatic traditions, without treating mathematics as proof of the Divine.

item.title: Chapter 12: TheTwo Minds Within
item.description: Explores split-brain research and the interpreter phenomenon, keeping story, signal, body, and context in dialogue for trustworthy perception.

item.title: Chapter 13: Weaving Wisdom into Action
item.description: Turns Part II into ordinary participation, translating cosmology into tone, contact, recollection, and small ethical action without losing the larger field.

item.title: Chapter 14: Scientific Pathways
item.description: Explores scientific concepts as companion languages for the Firmament, preserving distinctions between theorem, myth, and contemplative recognition.

item.title: Archetype Portals
item.description: Meet archetypes as living mirrors of patterns already moving through you. The Dragon holds changing currents around a trustworthy axis: what you serve.

item.title: Chapter 15: TheShadowThreshold
item.description: Meets Dark, Gray, and Golden Shadow, explores avoidance, and reclaims life-force through consent-bound stewardship of Eros.

item.title: Chapter 16: The Relational Dynamic
item.description: Explores Parent, Child, Sibling, and Lover dynamics, then follows parenting and care into responsibility, repair, Eros, and lineage.

item.title: Chapter 17:Archetypesof Action
item.description: Meets Warrior, Healer, Rebel, Sage, Trickster, Fool, and Magician through their gifts and shadows, keeping action and power ethically proportionate.

item.title: Chapter 18: Mirrors of Action andIntegration
item.description: Explore five mirrors of archetypal integration across body, relationship, and culture. Maturity guides how complementary forces are held and expressed.

item.title: Practices for Embodied Transformation
item.description: Bring insight into breath, body, and behaviour through small doses, grounding, and aftercare. Practise at a pace you can stop and a rhythm your body can trust.

item.title: Chapter 19: Reclaiming Your Innocence
item.description: Reclaims the Inner Child through somatic reparenting, emotional fluency, sensation tracking, and the return of safe play and curiosity.

item.title: Chapter 20: Pearls in the Abyss
item.description: Six bounded shadow-work practices meet grief and taboo charge through awareness, parts dialogue, discernment, and somatic aftercare.

item.title: Chapter 21: The Forge ofEros
item.description: Explores Eros as archetypal encounter through the Keeper of Eros, Shadow desire, Tantra, kink, sovereign relation, Living-Consent, and ethical return.

item.title: Chapter 22:StructureandFlow
item.description: Structure and Flow as embodied capacities beyond gender: Pillar and Wave, optional 4–4–6 breathing, relational range, and inner union.

item.title: TheCrucibleof Flesh
item.description: Read state before story. Recognizing bodily limits and the Fundamental Attribution Error opens space for self-understanding and compassion in daily life.

item.title: Chapter 23:The Dragon’s Circuitry
item.description: Maps neuroplasticity, nervous-system states, self-presence, co-regulation, and the protective stories of the Storyteller’s Throne.

item.title: Chapter 24: Spectrum of Diverse Minds
item.description: Explores neurodiversity through sensory load, access design, masking, burnout, late diagnosis, and unmasking as power conservation.

item.title: Chapter 25: Cellular Echoes of the Flesh
item.description: Explores trauma as present physiology, with titration, pendulation, somatic memory, and careful ancestral framing for gradual repatterning.

item.title: Chapter 26: The Gravity of Craving
item.description: Explores addiction as adaptation, distinguishing substances from behavioural compulsions while holding compassion, accountability, and supported recovery.

item.title: Chapter 27: Tides of the Flesh
item.description: Explores chemical signalling as inner weather that shifts timing, desire, sleep, bonding, pain, and recovery without dictating personality.

item.title: Chapter 28: The Soul’s Armor
item.description: Explores protective habits through conduct and context, distinguishing trauma-shaped defence from neurodivergence while preserving boundaries.

item.title: Chapter 29: The Alchemical Body
item.description: Brings medication and spiritual practice together through prescriber collaboration, interaction screening, and stability as the ground of transformation.

item.title: Chapter 30:Psychedelics
item.description: Examines psychedelic potentials and risks through medical screening, readiness, facilitator red flags, and integration as the measure of change.

item.title: Chapter 31: The Embodied Anchor
item.description: Turns Part V’s biological literacy into practical regulation choices through State Mapping, Somatic Intelligence, the Embodied Anchor, and the ECC Lens.

item.title: Ethics and Intimacy
item.description: Ethical intimacy joins power to dignity, Living-Consent, and responsibility, and keeps the freedom to love, question, refuse, and change.

item.title: Chapter 32: TheEthical Shadow
item.description: Follows an accurate grievance through a leader’s misreading, distinguishing conduct from interpretation while preserving accountability and safe exit.

item.title: Chapter 33: The Steward of Fire
item.description: Defines the Wise Facilitator through power-aware stewardship, Living-Consent, dissent protection, supervision, and accountable group practice.

item.title: Chapter 34: Tools for the Path
item.description: Tools for ethical contact under pressure: Reality Tether, Repair Protocol, Blast Radius Check, Generous Interpretation, and Clean Severance.

item.title: Void Meditation
item.description: Void Meditation is an advanced, optional encounter with stillness and mystery. Enter with sobriety, support, aftercare, and the capacity to stop and return.

item.title: Chapter 35: Significance of theVoid
item.description: Explores the Void and Void Body, distinguishing awake spaciousness from dissociation or freeze through clarity, anchor, and choice.

item.title: Chapter 36: Visions of theVoid
item.description: Offers Void visions as symbolic mirrors, drawing on traditions and scientific analogies while keeping interpretation provisional after return.

item.title: Chapter 37: Steps into Infinity
item.description: The Dragon’s Plunge: a Void Meditation protocol with grounding, optional waypoints, clear stop conditions, and integration after return.

item.title: Chapter 38: Living from theVoid
item.description: Brings Void contact into ordinary life through responsibility, boundaries, creativity, and care, with interpretation open to correction.

item.title: The Unfolding Path
item.description: Let integration take shape in ordinary life: presence, apology, rest, and beginning again. The path continues whether or not you entered Void Meditation.

item.title: Chapter 39: Beyond Duality
item.description: Revisits Indra’s Net, recursion, and the Field of Potential through Void contact or ordinary attention, bringing insight into relationship and action.

item.title: Chapter 40: TheSage’s Compass
item.description: Turns post-Void perception into action through the Seer/Sage distinction, Serene Center, paradox, lineage responsibility, and values under pressure.
